head: Orchard is an unofficial YouTube Music and Apple Music player
dek: Orchard, an open-source player for Windows, Linux and Android, plays your YouTube Music library or, with a subscription, Apple Music and Qobuz, with synced lyrics, a 10-band equalizer and Last.fm scrobbling. It's an independent project, not made or endorsed by Google or Apple, and the Android app is an APK from its own site.
